trail.text: Train service is spiking on every resource — hunting the trigger.
Train-service looks like the outlier, not a victim of traffic — checking its datastore and callers.
Callers are confirmed victims waiting on train-service — now establishing the timeline.
Timeline points to train-service as origin — gathering final victim evidence.
Cascade is mapped — pulling last proof for the upstream impact.

causes.reasoning: 450x sustained diskIO with 11x CPU and 3.4x mem from 7s, workload flat and train-mongo healthy, so internal fault not traffic or DB; direct callers degrade after it.
Direct caller of train-service (5707 calls); DB ops flat but train-dependent ops train_types/admin_trip p95 10x with onset at 15s after train resource spike, classic victim.
Direct caller of train-service; DB finds healthy but admin_trip p95 80ms->1178ms and onset at 121s, downstream cascade from train.
Direct caller of train-service; POST /basic/travel p95 50ms->781ms with latency onset at 17s matching train latency, victim of train slowness.
Upstream of travel/travel2; no resource spike but latency 0.06->0.147 with seats ops p95 2x, indirect victim of train via travel services.
